changes_summary: Added a mandatory deterministic, fail-closed finalizer feasibility-admission phase before execution or resume, with atomic probe, collision checks, admission hash propagation, and validation/CI ordering. Preserved the existing m7 scope, external-editor limitation, performance-budget limitation, and m8 deferral.

flags_addressed.reason: Added explicit pre-execution finalizer admission and fail-closed evidence dependency.
Admission now checks required inputs, output collisions, and atomic finalizer feasibility before resume.
Admission status and hash are carried into acceptance evidence and gate completion.
Validation order begins with admission integrity and revalidates before finalization.
The plan states the concrete owner, artifact path, atomic probe, and blocking conditions.
No alternate approach or scope expansion was needed; the existing hardening plan remains aligned and gains the missing custody gate.

questions: What is the approved representative-fixture and numeric performance-budget source? Until supplied, m7 records a provisional fixture and report-only measurements.
Will execution receive an authorized checkout of the pinned Reigh editor commit and permission to run its provider/persistence selectors?
Should real generation/render continue to mean the existing deterministic credential-free in-tree adapters that traverse repositories, tasks, and media?

success_criteria.criterion: Finalizer feasibility admission runs before execution or resume, fails closed on missing/stale/conflicting/indeterminate inputs, and its status/hash is present in final m7 evidence.
`make m7-gate` fails closed unless GA items 1–10 have executed green evidence, item 11 is provisional, item 12 is retained source/test evidence pending m8, and finalizer admission is admitted.
Backup and restore kill-boundary tests recover only prior-valid or complete-new state with no mixed database/media state.

Corruption, migration mismatch, media mutation/missingness, staging GC, contention, bridge Range/error behavior, and dogfood journeys meet the stated m7 invariants without doctor mutation or alternate authority.
Performance evidence records fixture identity and cold/warm samples; approved budgets receive dispositions, while unresolved budgets remain non-blocking.
Clean-machine documentation and repository-wide regression/lint/typecheck gates pass; external editor proof and installed-artifact proof are labeled honestly when unavailable or deferred.
No severity-one or severity-two correctness defect remains open in the m7 ledger.

assumptions: The existing m7 fixture, repository-backed operations, and credential-free adapters remain the intended implementation surfaces.
Finalizer admission is deterministic and can probe the exact artifact directory without modifying immutable plan ledgers.
External Reigh proof remains unavailable unless an authorized checkout is supplied; it is never inferred from the in-tree substitute.
No approved v10 performance budget is silently reconstructed; measurements remain report-only until a normative source exists.
Packaged-install and installed-artifact proof remains m8 scope.
